fields.name: enabled
fields.doc: Explicit operator enable; provisional default is disabled.

fields.name: min_edge
fields.doc: Required net return after both taker fees and price allowances; must be set before enabling.

fields.name: slip
fields.doc: IOC price allowance on each leg; provisional default crosses only the touch.

fields.name: depth_frac
fields.doc: Fraction of each taking top level; provisional default 50 percent.

fields.name: max_chunk_notional
fields.doc: Per-leg order notional cap; must be set before enabling.

fields.name: max_position_notional
fields.doc: Absolute position notional cap on each leg; must be set before enabling.

fields.name: max_quote_age_ms
fields.doc: Opportunity age limit on both quotes, distinct from connection health; provisional 5 ms.

fields.name: cooldown_ms
fields.doc: Minimum engine time between attempts including gated and shadow attempts; provisional 100 ms.

fields.name: max_hedge_failures
fields.doc: Consecutive hedge failures before requesting a group halt; provisional three.

notes.name: Fired
notes.doc: One simultaneous pair of bounded IOC legs accepted by Ctx.

notes.name: HedgeFailed
notes.doc: Either leg rejected, empty expiry or a new Broken episode; once per pair.

notes.name: Halted
notes.doc: Group halt requested at the configured hedge failure limit.
